Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 49 (Lumen Technologies missing-address campaign): matched this row to the sole Lumen facility a dedicated aggregator listing shows for this exact city.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Lumen Technologies is the current legal successor to CenturyLink, which itself absorbed Level 3 Communications in a 2017 acquisition, with the CenturyLink brand renamed Lumen in 2020. Legacy Level 3 branding persists on some facilities and aggregator listings and is preserved in this registry per its no delete policy rather than overwritten. This specific row, Lumen Technologies, in Tustin, California, was matched via a dedicated datacentermap listing, fetched fresh this session, which is the only Lumen facility that site lists for this exact city, giving 14452 Franklin Avenue, Tustin, California 92780 as the street address. The listing itself notes the facility was originally branded Level 3 Communications.

reading.body:
This facility has no published power specification. The campus is a Lumen Technologies location in Tustin, California, originally built and branded by Level 3 Communications. Without disclosed IT load or total campus power, its capacity for AI workloads cannot be assessed from operator data.

California has 103 mapped data center facilities, of which only 11 operators publish power figures totaling 365 megawatts. This Lumen campus does not appear in that published set, placing it outside the state's disclosed capacity baseline used to track AI infrastructure.

Facilities that do not publish power specifications remain invisible to grid and scaling analysis, even when they exist and operate. Whether this location contributes to AI deployment in California cannot be determined from available facts.
